metadata.name: Naive CD8+ T cell
metadata.description: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has not experienced activation via antigen contact and has the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CCR7-positive and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD62L-high and CD44-low.

synonyms.synonym: naive thymus-dervied CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte
